raw: {"diagnosis": "anterior MI", "stemi": "no", "rationale": "The rhythm is sinus with left axis deviation, QS complexes in V1–V3 and poor R-wave progression, which point to an old or age-indeterminate anterior (anteroseptal) infarct, but no two contiguous leads show enough new ST elevation to meet STEMI criteria (only about ≤1 mm in V2–V3, with no reciprocal changes), so I disagree that this is an acute STEMI."}

parsed.rationale: The rhythm is sinus with left axis deviation, QS complexes in V1–V3 and poor R-wave progression, which point to an old or age-indeterminate anterior (anteroseptal) infarct, but no two contiguous leads show enough new ST elevation to meet STEMI criteria (only about ≤1 mm in V2–V3, with no reciprocal changes), so I disagree that this is an acute STEMI.
